name: Delmonico Rib-Eye Steak with Black Garlic Butter & Whipped Yukon Potatoes (Night 1)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Treasure · Worlds of Marvel (Quantum Encounter Night 1)
whyItWorks: Paired with silky whipped Yukon gold potatoes; rib-eye has more intramuscular marbling than tenderloin so trimming visible fat keeps it gentle.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order medium-rare with plain butter or salt only (hold the black garlic compound butter and cracked peppercorn crust) alongside the whipped Yukon potatoes.
watchOuts: Higher marbling fat in rib-eye vs. filet mignon
